meta_description:
17K likes, 137 comments - prernachhabra on October 7, 2024: "Officially the 9th month has started and as much as the delivery process makes me nervous I’m supremely excited to meet our little one. The past few months have been quite the roller coaster ride. On some days I’d feel extremely energetic and the next I’d lie in bed the whole day being emotional for no real reason, haha.

As some of you might know, before I started my content creation/ influencer (whatever you wanna call it!) journey I used to work at Fabindia. It is at this amazing organization that I developed a taste for Indian handicrafts like the Ajrakhs, the Indigos, the Applique .. and visits to the handicraft clusters made me realise the kind of hard work that goes behind such craftsmanship. Coming to the point, since then I’ve had the opportunity to work with multiple brands in this category and very recently I got to work with @maaticrafts (a brand that I’ve long admired for their contemporary designs and a strong focus on delivering quality products). Even my mum is in awe of their pieces and in general very excited that they all fit her as well.. haha!!

I’d like to believe that it’s our baby who has brought us this good luck and also tons of energy for her mum to continue working during this time. Let’s see what’s in store for the next few weeks and finally when our Diwali baby decides to arrive. ❤️🥰💕

#prernachhabra #stylinginspirations #pregnancy #pregnancythoughts #pregnancyootd #pregnancyfeelings #1sttimemum #pregnancyfashion #saree #indianwear #smallbusiness #pregnancyjourney #ethnicwear".
